About this item

  • POWERFUL BRIGHTNESS: Illuminate up to 7m of your home or business with 3000* lumens of light; The Arlo outdoor security light with camera that's brighter than a car headlight
  • 100% WIRELESS FLOODLIGHT: Quickly install for instant protection and peace of mind with the world’s first wireless floodlight camera; Connect directly to WiFi, no base station required
  • 2K VIDEO WITH HDR: The only floodlight camera with 2K, zoom in outdoors up to 12x on important details; Full colour night vision thanks to the powerful floodlight camera
  • REACT & RESPOND: Choose how you want to respond to an alert; Hear and speak to visitors with 2-way audio or activate built-in siren to deter intruders
  • SOLAR POWER OPTIONS: Use the long-lasting, rechargeable battery with included Micro USB charger or purchase an Arlo Solar panel or outdoor charging cable for continuous power;
  • ARLO SECURE SUBSCRIPTION (sold separately) backs up videos securely to the cloud; Detects more than any other brand; identify & prioritise people, cars, pets & packages, focus with activity zones; Subscription also includes camera theft protection insurance; 90 day trial included;
  • WITHOUT SUBSCRIPTION Arlo Cameras offer live stream, motion alerts and two-way talk direct to your mobile; Paired with a base station, local storage is also an option
  • 160 DEGREE VIEW: Keep an eye on more of what matters with a wider field of view from your camera lens
  • SMART HOME INTEGRATION: Control your Arlo Pro 3 Floodlight camera with your Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant; Control with Apple HomeKit when connected to an Arlo SmartHub
  • The first motion activated floodlight with an integrated 2K security CCTV camera that is entirely battery powered with no mains-wiring required – as of January 2020

  3. At Arlo we believe a watched over space is a safer space.

    We make industry-leading security cameras, video doorbells and floodlights that give you the power to stay connected to your home, 24/7.

    Protect your home today.

  4. Part of Verisure

    We’re proud to be a part of Verisure, the global leader of monitored security solutions.

  5. Arlo Secure AI Subscription

    Unlock an extra layer of protection with Secure: AI-powered early threat detection, now with an emergency SOS button for instant help.

  6. Award Winning Security

    We have over 100 awards for our cameras and services from some of the most reputable technology award-bodies in the world.

  7. Privacy Protection

    Your protection is our priority, so we use the highest privacy standards so your information remains safe and in your control.

  8. Easy Installation

    Unbox and go - set-up in minutes with just a few screws and no wires.

  9. Recommended Brand

    Join over 5 million homeowners and businesses who trust Arlo to watch over the things they care about most.

  10. Smart Home Integration

    All Arlo cameras are compatible with most voice assistants including Alexa, Google Home and Apple HomeKit*. (*with Basestation)

  11. Protecting homes & businesses

    Our professional grade cameras and powerful software are just as effective at protecting your business as they are your home.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Very good camera and floodlight
I wanted a light on the side of the house and have Arlo cameras anyway and so I tried this and I think it is very good, and the light is excellent even just on battery. I have solar panels on both, ( I bought a second one because I was impressed), and at the moment they stay at 100% with the fairly sunny days, however winter they will need recharging if in a busy area, but I have purchased an outdoor magnetic charging cable that will make this easy, otherwise you have to separate the camera from the housing to charge and this would be a pain. One slight problem is an intermittent noise that comes over the feed when live and on recordings which is annoying. It doesn’t happen every time so hopefully firmware updates sort it out. I can live with it just, but some may find it too much annoyance , so hope to be fixed in future. I do recommend these cameras when paired with solar panels and am glad I bought them.

    Bought two of these now (one for my mother-in-law) and we are very happy with them. Firstly I like the design which looks neat and high tech. Installation and set up was easy although there were few quirks learnt along the way. If you have the patience reading the full manual is very worthwhile as the camera is quite complex.

    I had to change SSID twice and the routine in the app never worked - both times I had to remove the device from the app and reinstall.

    The audio trigger goes off every few seconds when it is windy so we had to deactivate that feature - tricky to find how to do that in the section on Modes.

    To avoid having to recharge the battery (and there are issues about how often this is needed) you need to add either outdoor charging cable or the solar panel. Early days but the Solar panel seems to work very well.

    1 out of 5 stars
    ok when they worked but terrible UK support when they ddidn't
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 15 December 2020
    Colour Name: WhiteStyle Name: Floodlight Cam
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Bought two floodlight cameras - initially pretty happy. After a few weeks one lost connection with wifi so I took down and reset. Then a few weeks later the other lost connection, but refused to reconnect. After lots of web searches and multiple unsuccessful attempts to fix myself I tried to reach out to Arlo support. This is where the fun begins...

    I first tried using the online chat support. Answered questions, provided serial numbers, received a case number and was told to call a UK number as the online support is for the US only. So far, I'm fine with this. I was given an 0800 uk number which i called at around 2pm on a Friday. After waiting about 45 mins in a queue, (music played for 5 mins, then 40 odd mins of silence), I was put through to another US support operator. After several checks with colleagues, I was told that US support can't help me and that UK support is only open 8-5 Mon to Fri so I'd be contacted on Monday. I tried to explain that it was only 3pm on a Friday in the UK, but was told I couldn't be transferred but that I would receive a phone call Monday. Monday came and went. As did Tuesday. I called on Wednesday. Same routine, 50+ mins on hold (only first 5 mins with music, then 45 mins of unsettling silence... (had i been disconnected, should i hang up?), I was put through to US operator again. Again told I needed to call the UK number.

    At this point I gave up with Arlo support, and contacted Amazon. Amazingly, after only 10 mins, they put me through to a European Arlo support person. Only to be asked by this person to please call the Arlo UK support number because he only answered because it was Amazon who called him. I clarified the number i was originally given was the UK / European support number, which it was, so I refused to hang up and call, explaining my previous experiences.

    At this point I was advised based on the case notes, the cameras were probably faulty and I should return them for an exchange. I was told i could return 1 to Arlo, but as I'd bought them together, they might both be faulty and I could return both to the dealer I purchased them from, Amazon. Why I couldn't have been told this from the start.. God only knows.

    The guy said he'd hang up and I'd return to the Amazon support who would organise the exchange. He hung up and of course the line when dead. Then and there, I organised a prompt collection and full refund from Amazon.

    Horrible experience. Wont ever buy from Arlo again.

  • JP reviews
    5 out of 5 stars
    Great floodlight and camera combo
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 29 May 2023
    Colour Name: BlackStyle Name: Floodlight Cam
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Working this review after 21 months of use. The quality and sensor is pretty good. Battery life was our main concern, which hadn’t been a problem ; charging every 6-8 months. Obviously charge rate depends upon how much it’s armed and triggered. Battery longevity also varies ever so slightly by outdoor temperatures. On the very odd and rare occasions (approximately 2/3), the camera has been covered by dew.

    The camera quality and range is really clear. You can also use the intercom to speak if needed. What’s great is that you can set your own trigger zones (handy for neighbouring fence lines). I only have one critiqué, the time lag on a person being captured in a zone to the alert on your phone could/should be far quicker. The delay is significant enough that if you were wanting to interrupt an intruder you may be a little late. However, the delay hasn’t put me off the device and quality as this can be improved in software updates. Subsequent, I have gone onto purchase a second device.

    Other reason for picking this brand over others was to do with secure service (so far!!), one other brand available to purchase via this platform has had breaches.

    Hope this review helps you make your own personal home security decision.

    I wanted a light on the side of the house and have Arlo cameras anyway and so I tried this and I think it is very good, and the light is excellent even just on battery.

    I have solar panels on both, ( I bought a second one because I was impressed), and at the moment they stay at 100% with the fairly sunny days, however winter they will need recharging if in a busy area, but I have purchased an outdoor magnetic charging cable that will make this easy, otherwise you have to separate the camera from the housing to charge and this would be a pain.

    One slight problem is an intermittent noise that comes over the feed when live and on recordings which is annoying. It doesn’t happen every time so hopefully firmware updates sort it out.

    I can live with it just, but some may find it too much annoyance , so hope to be fixed in future.

    I do recommend these cameras when paired with solar panels and am glad I bought them.

  • Emteq
    3 out of 5 stars
    Arlo price gauge you after purchase
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 24 October 2021
    Colour Name: WhiteStyle Name: Floodlight Cam
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    In itself this is decent camera but the ownership experience is tarnished by price gauging by Arlo/Netgear.

    Not just the monthly subscription which is pretty much essential but the ridiculous £40 cost of their outdoor charging cable with proprietary magnetic charging connector. They slyly stop the camera functioning if you plus in a normal micro-USB to charge the battery.

    On the plus side the camera and light have plenty of adjustments for sensitivity, lens angle, illumination time etc. I was able to 'tune' the settings to get a good picture but avoid triggering by foxes etc.

    The other good feature is WiFi sensitivity even though just the 2.4GHz band is supported. Arlo must have used the extra size to include a better antenna, the signal strength is much better than an Arlo Essential camera in the same location.

    Regarding mounting, you must place this where it can't be reached, as one button push will detach the entire camera unit from its case! Arlo really should have made this key-operated.

    With coupon, I picked this up for £133 which goes someway to paying the subscription. To be fair, up to five camera are covered by the subscription which adds features such as one camera can trigger others to record, send 'push' notifications etc.

    Also, unlike Ring, Arlo doesn't integrate with a home alarm system. To remain competitive they'll need to get an alarm to the market PDQ.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Good camera : was(but forget 6 months battery life)
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 1 January 2021
    Colour Name: WhiteStyle Name: Floodlight Cam
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I like the camera, it connected easily to our network, and the app is intuitive. There are loads of options to adjust the settings and I even don’t mind the subscription after the three month trial. The downside is the battery life. See edit at bottom. There is no way on this planet it

    will last up to 6 months as stated on the Arlo website (with the caveat: Based on usage of 4000 seconds per month, 30 seconds per stream, and day/night event splits 2:1. Will vary with device settings, use, activity captured and environmental factors.)

    With the light on 5% I managed 9 days the first charge. Since switching the light off altogether it managed 15 days the second charge. I also have the solar panel on a south facing aspect, albeit during the darkest months of winter. I’m quite disappointed by the battery life to be honest.

    EDIT: I moved the camera away from the boiler vent and now the battery life is as advertised and am very happy with it. I couldn’t believe why a difference it’s made. Since moving it’s been at 100% with the solar panel.

Product description

A powerful shield of light from the world’s first wire-free floodlight camera. Instantly illuminate and film up to 7-metres of your property with 3000* lumen light more powerful than a car headlight. The only floodlight camera with 2K capabilities, zoom in up to 12x on important details and capture colour video even at night. Easily protect the most vulnerable parts of your property thanks to the 100% wire-free design and connect to your smartphone for instant notifications when motion is detected. Combine with an Arlo Service Plans subscription to enhance your notifications and receive alerts specifically when a person or vehicle is detected.

**The first motion-activated floodlight with an integrated 2K security camera that is entirely battery powered with no mains-wiring required – as of January 2020.
